name: Instruct2DS
description: Instruct2DS is a benchmark dataset supporting live data collection from web sources across academic, finance, and sports domains. It is designed to evaluate automated web data collection systems with minimal human intervention, facilitated by a multi-agent system architecture.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for autonomous web data collection, with interest mainly in agentic data-extraction research rather than broad community adoption.
notes: Supports live web data collection across three domains; introduced alongside AutoData multi-agent system.
